packs.name: Electrical
packs.description: Branch circuits in NM cable and in EMT with their conductors, straps and fittings; receptacles, switches and boxes; light fixtures; panelboards; data outlets and Cat 6 runs. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Drywall and framing
packs.description: Gypsum board partitions by height (8, 9, 10, 12 ft) and layers on steel or wood studs, wall linings, ceilings, corner bead and trim, exterior 2x6 walls and rough openings. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Painting
packs.description: Interior walls by height (new and repaint), wall areas, ceilings, doors and frames, trim, caulk, exterior siding and block, epoxy floors. Spread rates are starting figures to replace with your products’ data sheets. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Concrete
packs.description: Slabs on grade (with mesh or rebar, vapor retarder and base), continuous footings, foundation walls with rebar and forms, pad footings, piers, columns, flatwork and curing. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Flooring
packs.description: Floor and wall tile (on concrete or on backer board), luxury vinyl plank, VCT, broadloom carpet and carpet tile, solid hardwood, resilient base, transitions and self-leveling underlayment. Coverage figures are starting points to replace with your products’ data sheets. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Masonry
packs.description: Modular brick veneer with ties, 8 in and 12 in concrete block walls with joint reinforcement, through-wall flashing and weeps, loose lintels and adhered stone veneer. Units and mortar follow from the module geometry. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Roofing, residential
packs.description: Architectural asphalt shingles with underlayment, drip edge, starter and nails; tear-off; ice barrier at eaves; ridge and hip cap with ridge vent; valleys; step flashing; pipe boots; standing-seam metal panels. Use the pitch on the item so areas are true roof surfaces. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Roofing, commercial
packs.description: TPO (mechanically attached), EPDM (fully adhered) and two-ply modified bitumen systems over polyiso, tapered areas, roof edges and copings, drains, pipe and curb flashings, walkway pads. Attachment counts are starting figures for the wind design to replace. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Siding
packs.description: Vinyl and fiber-cement lap siding with water-resistive barrier and fasteners, J-channel, corner posts, starter strip, vented soffit and fascia. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Finish carpentry
packs.description: Base, shoe, chair rail and crown with nails; interior doors cased both sides; window casing, stool and apron; closet shelf and rod; base and wall cabinets with countertop and backsplash. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Plumbing
packs.description: PVC drain, waste and vent pipe; copper and PEX water lines with hangers at the code spacing; water closets, lavatories, kitchen sinks, shower valves, floor drains, hose bibbs and water heaters with their trim. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: HVAC
packs.description: Rectangular and spiral duct by size with hangers and wrap, insulated flexible duct with supports, supply diffusers, registers and return grilles, exhaust fans, thermostats and split systems. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Insulation
packs.description: Wall batts by height (R-13, R-21), blown-in attic R-49 with baffles and rulers, rigid foam board, closed-cell spray foam by board feet, polyethylene vapor retarder and sound batts. R-values follow your climate zone. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Landscape
packs.description: Sod on topsoil, seed with straw, planting beds with soil, fabric and mulch, metal edging, trees and shrubs, spray irrigation zones and valves, concrete pavers on base and sand. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: Decking
packs.description: Wood or composite deck surface with joists, screws, hangers and rim; ledger with fasteners and flashing; beams; footings with posts; guards with balusters; stairs by riser. Spans and sizes come from the IRC deck section or DCA 6. Assemblies only: set your own rates.

packs.name: General contractor, by CSI division
packs.description: A starter estimate by CSI MasterFormat division: general requirements, demolition, concrete, masonry, metals, wood, thermal and moisture, openings, finishes, specialties, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, earthwork, exterior improvements and utilities. With the workbook’s material list, quote request, takeoff summary, by-division sheet and markups for labor burden, tax, overhead, profit and bond. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
